about_the_game:
The desert wind carries whispers of a forgotten era. Beneath the pale glow of a motionless moon, an ancient palace rises from the sands - a marvel of Mughal Mechanicum, where time has long since ceased to move. 

You, a speechless automaton, find yourself drawn to its doors, guided by the presence of a steampunk genie companion whose purpose remains as enigmatic as the palace itself.

Step inside, and uncover the secrets of a palace frozen in time.

Explore a 2D world where the elegance of Mughal architecture intertwines with the intricate machinery of steampunk engineering.

Engage in a point-and-click math puzzle adventure, where every room holds hidden mechanisms, cryptic notes, and lost technology waiting to be uncovered.

What fate led you here? What mysteries lie beyond these great gates?

The palace holds answers—but only to those willing to seek them.

🔹 A Mughal Steampunk Fantasy – A world of ornate palaces, celestial observatories, and intricate clockwork technology, blending South Asian artistry with mechanical steampunk wonders.

🔹 Point-and-Click Exploration – Interact with beautifully animated objects, uncover hidden puzzles, and collect time gems to manipulate the world around you.

🔹 Unique Time-Based Puzzles – Align analog and digital timekeepers, and restore the palace’s long-lost mechanisms.

🔹 Your Steampunk Genie Companion – A mysterious mechanical guide who offers hints, cryptic insights, and glimpses into a forgotten past.

🔹 Secrets Buried in Time – Search for lost relics and unravel a mystery that spans centuries—perhaps even unlocking a door long thought lost to time...

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU 2.5 GHz+

short_description: Dive into a Mughal Steampunk world where math puzzles, steam-powered contraptions, and hidden stories await! Solve challenges inspired by Eastern and South Asian cultures, tinker with intricate machines, and explore a palace frozen in time. A fun adventure for families and puzzle lovers!
